authorisation.quote: Write the dated cap-112 authorisation document for the comparator, Q1 and Q2, recording the owner's grant against the three frozen records.
authorisation.scope: the three cap-112 records: PRESENCE-COMPARATOR-112, PRESENCE-CONSTRUCT-1-112 and PRESENCE-CAP-1-112, once the cap is landed and a harness exists
authorisation.why: the recorded 2026-11-11 instruction authorises preparation of `docs/AUTHORISATION-PRESENCE-CAP-112.md`, not the execution of cells. The two blocks that ran are reclassified provisional in `docs/CAP-112-PROVENANCE-DISPOSITION.md`; the instruction does not land the cap and does not authorise a run under cap 40.

runner.refuses: `--measure` refuses while the shipped cap is not 112, the installed version is not 0.15.0, the pin does not name it, or the block canaries were not re-recorded on the installed bytes
runner.why: the three blocks are implemented against these frozen designs and their gates. The comparator's seven planned runs (six audit seeds plus the control) executed on 2026-11-11; Q1 and Q2 remain unrun.

amendments.reason: the owner's grant of 2026-11-11 authorised the cells, and the runners were the separate step the draft named
amendments.disclosure: `benchmarks/presence_cap112_runners.py` implements the comparator, Q1 and Q2 cells and their gates, with verdict rules and gate controls that run on hand-built rows. `--measure` refuses on this build: the shipped cap is 40 and the installed version is 0.14.0. No cell has run, no verdict is adjudicated, and the design, seeds, gates and verdict rules above are unchanged.

amendments.disclosure: `SleepService.MAX_PREDICTIONS` is 112 and the package is 0.15.0. Each of the four runner conditions is met, so the records are runnable; landing does not run them. The records' status stays FROZEN, NOT RUN and their design, seeds, gates and verdict rules are unchanged. The 0.14.0 cap-40 records are superseded, not re-scored: each carries a dated build_superseded block.

amendments.reason: the preflight became empty when 0.15.0 landed, and the owner's 2026-11-11 grant already covered these cells
amendments.disclosure: The seven planned runs executed on 2026-11-11: six audit seeds and the control, on the shipped 0.15.0 build at cap 112. `--finish` wrote docs/presence_comparator_112_run.json and docs/PRESENCE-COMPARATOR-112-RESULT.md; the verdict is `PRESENCE NOT ASSERTION`, all six gates A1-A6 pass, and the asserted world edges are 51-64 of 112 (conversion 0.455-0.571). Status moved to FROZEN, RUN. The design, seeds, gates, verdict rule and acceptance condition are unchanged, and no other block ran.

not_evidence: Executed without a recorded owner run authorisation. The numerical result and gates stand as recorded but are provisional; this is not an owner-authorised or confirmatory cap-112 result.
question: On a build whose Layer-1 cap is 112, are presence and assertion the same object on the same world edges, the same build and the same observation window -- and does the 0.14.0 comparator's reading survive the level?
claim: The comparator measures present edges and asserted world edges as sets on one build. At cap 40 it returned `PRESENCE NOT ASSERTION`: the asserted set was a strict subset of presence. This record re-asks the same question at 112 so the level change is not read through a cap-40 instrument.

design.world: the Gate-13 compositional world (16 tags, 112 derivable edges)
design.pairing: one cell per audit seed; each cell pairs with the cap-112 row of the same seed
design.reuse: The six historical audit seeds, reused so the level comparison is paired per seed. This is reuse and is disclosed; it is not an independence claim.

gates.A1_build: one build, one sha256, the cap 112 the pin will name; no mixed-build row
gates.A2_world: one W per seed, no perturbation of order or window
gates.A3_denominator: W, P and S_ever non-empty in every cell; a zero denominator is not measurable
gates.A4_object: the asserted edge set is recorded as a set, not a count
gates.A5_seed_axis: at least two distinct (P, S_ever, A_W) fingerprints across the six seeds
gates.A6_control: a fresh-process rerun of seed 20261100 reproduces its fingerprints

verdict_rule: the comparator's own `_verdict(rows)` over the six cells, unchanged: `PRESENCE NOT FULL`, `PRESENCE NOT ASSERTION`, `PRESENCE AND ASSERTION COINCIDE`
gates_control: `_verdict` is checked against a hand-built row set for each of its three verdicts before any cell runs, so a verdict that cannot be reached is a draft defect rather than a result.

provenance_disposition.effect: The numerical result and gates stand as recorded; the run is not owner-authorised and may not be cited as a confirmatory cap-112 result.

seed_reuse: the six historical audit seeds, reused so the level comparison is paired; declared against docs/presence_assertion_audit_0.14.0.json
